_comment: Skills designed but not yet in the box, from the 2026-10-31 design. One plain line each, grouped like skills.json. A skill is removed from here the day its folder lands in .claude/skills/; the generator also drops any entry whose folder already exists, so the page never shows a skill twice.

media-tools: Convert, trim, resize, make a GIF, pull the audio out, strip metadata, batch a folder.
summarize: A document, transcript, thread or folder into a short brief with the decisions and open items.
explain-this: A contract, bill, medical letter or notice in plain words, with the three things to do about it.
paperwork: Scan or photo in, read, named by date and type, filed, and the dates that matter pulled out.
document-builder: Markdown into Word, PowerPoint, PDF, and spreadsheets into CSV.
photo-organizer: Rename by date taken, find duplicates, sort by month. Nothing uploaded, nothing deleted.
meeting-prep: What the workspace knows about a person or company, plus a web read, on one page.
writer: Emails, replies, notes and short documents, in your voice.
social-copywriter: Posts for nine platforms, each in that platform's format and habits.
resume-and-letter: A resume tailored to a posting, the cover letter, and letters with stakes: a dispute, a landlord, a refund.
money-log: Bank or card export in, categorized monthly summary and recurring charges out. No bank connection.
trip-plan: Bookings in, one itinerary out, with what is still unbooked.
doctor: Checks every tool and sign-in, re-installs only what is missing.
undo: Version history on the workspace, so "undo what you just did" works.
outbound-check: Before anything leaves: secrets, account numbers, other people's names, your address.
weekly-brief: What came in, what went out, dates coming due, gaps logged, sign-ins needed.
workspace-audit: Checks the map and routing files against what is on disk and reports the drift.
